changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwpreauthorizationitem AS SELECT pai.id, pai.pre_authorization_id, pai.sequence, pai.item_type, pai.item_code, pai.item_description, pai.non_standard_code, pai.non_standard_desc, pai.is_package, pai.is_maternity, pai.quantity, pai.quantity_code, pai.unit_price, pai.discount, pai.factor, pai.tax_percent, pai.tax, pai.patient_share_percent, pai.patient_share, pai.payer_share, pai.net, pai.start_date, pai.end_date, pai.invoice_no, pai.body_site, pai.sub_site, pai.brand_medication_id, pai.diagnostic_test_id, pai.service_id, pai.procedure_id, pai.waseel_item_id, pai.item_decision, pai.reason_codes, pai.raw_json, pai.created_date, pai.created_by, pai.last_modified_by, pai.last_modified_date FROM public.pre_authorization_item pai;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
